name: Adaptive Residual Vector Quantization (ARQ) with Context-Guided Recovery
aliases: Adaptive Residual Vector Quantization (ARQ) with Context-Guided Recovery and Attribute Adaptation
definition: A compression method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that compresses high-dimensional anchor features using three-stage residual vector quantization (RVQ) with per-anchor adaptive depth, recovers features using spatial context, and refines quantized offsets and scaling using an attribute adapter.
summary: Adaptive Residual Vector Quantization with Context-Guided Recovery compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by using per-anchor adaptive depth and spatial context to refine features, producing a single optimized representation rather than multiple reconstruction levels.
